action_args.justification: The series has a strong trend (0.95) and strong seasonality (0.64), and the top-3 models (THETA, ETS, ARIMA) all sit in the same correlated-error group, so adding more models or fitting weights over 3 windows adds variance without signal. The trimmed mean over the 5 most stable models (pool1) already captures the trend/seasonality structure robustly, and the runner-up is not statistically distinguishable. Accepting the seed is the disciplined choice.
